articles.title: Claude Reaches GA on Microsoft Foundry: European Enterprises Cannot Deploy It
articles.reason: This article provides critical deployment limitations for Claude on Azure relevant to EU data residency and compliance, directly impacting enterprise AI architecture decisions for German finance and insurance clients.
articles.summary: Claude models are now generally available on Microsoft Foundry with Azure-native integration, but lack a European data zone, making them non-compliant for production use in EU-regulated sectors like banking and insurance. Anthropic's documentation confirms that data residency guarantees do not extend to Foundry, and practitioners in regulated industries report the offering is not approved for production. This directly affects model selection and deployment strategies for EU-based enterprise clients.
actionable_insights: Exclude Claude on Foundry from production RFPs and architecture plans for EU-regulated clients until EU data residency is supported.
Communicate these limitations to stakeholders in finance and insurance to avoid compliance risks.
Monitor for future updates on EU data zone availability for Claude on Azure to reassess deployment options.
